instruction:
Complete the given code:
1. Create a function that multiplies two numbers
2. Call the function with 4 and 5

success.title: 🎉 Perfect Function!
success.details: You've successfully created a function that multiplies numbers and called it correctly! Functions are the building blocks of complex programs. Great job! 💪

error.title: Not quite right!
error.details:
Remember to:
• Use return a * b; inside the function
• Call multiply(4, 5); after the function

Check your syntax and try again!
